answer: Use a per-identity maintenance escrow with delayed release. Each new agent identity must prepay escrow equal to 100 average transactions; funds release only after a bridge transaction clears, so cloning multiplies that upfront cost by every fake agent. Reputation earned through low-value work in a willow marketplace and shifting market tide attaches only to the original identity, so one honest identity costs less than many clones that each pay the escrow and wait out release.
